newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower, no radical revival seen.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower, no radical revival seen.

text.p: The Czech PX50 moved lower on Thursday in light trading with dealers saying there was little chance of a sustained upturn until the economy begins to show clear signs of a revival.

"I don't see any radical reason why market sentiment should change...Investors are waiting for some real results after the government's efforts to implement changes," said Karel Ruzicka of ING Barings.
On Tuesday, the government won a confidence vote, by just two votes, and pledged to push on with austerity measures and radical reforms to put the Czech economic transformation process back on track.
With the two biggest issues on the index, CEZ and SPT Telecom temporarily suspended, activity was light.
Other major issues had a mixed day. Komercni Banka declined 67 crowns to 1,983, Ceska Sporitelna rose 11 crowns to 308, IPB fell seven crowns to 285 and Tabak lost 234 crowns to 7,666.
